slides.sub: The 3-step system that cuts email time by more than half.

body.t: Paste the email you received into ChatGPT or Claude. Then write ONE messy sentence about what you want to say. That's your whole input.
Never start from a blank page.

slides.headline: Use a reusable prompt.
slides.sub: Same prompt every time. Keep it saved as a text shortcut.
slides.label: COPY THIS PROMPT
slides.code:
Reply to this email. My rough answer:
[YOUR SENTENCE].

Rules:
- 3 sentences max
- my tone: direct, warm, no filler
- end with a clear next step
- no "I hope this finds you well"

body.t: The AI gets you to 90%. You add the one detail only you know — a name, a date, a decision.
If you edit more than 10%, your prompt rules need updating, not the draft.
